inlines.v: CHAPTER, noun 1. A division of a book or treatise; as, Genesis contains fifty chapters. Hence the phrase, to the end of the chapter that is, throughout; to the end. 2. In ecclesiastical polity, a society or community of clergymen, belonging to a cathedral or collegiate church. 3. A place where delinquents receive discipline and correction. 4. A decretal epistle. CHAPTER, verb transitive To tax; to correct.
